Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out in the middle. Munim Shahriar and Litton Das will open the batting for Bangladesh. Richard Ngarava will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is a big one, the batting track is good but the odd ball is staying low. If Zimbabwe bowl well, they can easily defend this as the boundaries are quite big. Bangladesh needs to bat brilliantly if they are to have any chance. Who will take the lead in this series? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay!

Bangladesh will be very disappointed with their effort. They are a side who are in form with the ball but they were taken to the cleaners today. Most of their bowlers had an economy rate of over 9 except for the two offices Mosaddek Hossain and Afif Hossain. A forgetful day for the others.

There were starts for most of the top order players for Zimbabwe but when Sikandar Raza walked in, the game was probably evenly poised. The launching pad was set for Zimbabwe with one set batter in but they could easily been contained if wickets would have fallen regularly. That though was not the case, Sikandar Raza took the attack to the bowlers and along with Wesley Madhevere who played brilliantly with him smashed the ball to all parts of the ground. No time throughout the innings did it look like Zimbabwe would get close to 200 but thanks to Sikandar Raza who played a blinder of 65 runs in just 26 balls and Wesley Madhevere they got there.

What a batting performance from Zimbabwe and they surely have a score above par! Chasing is usually not easy on this ground and that knock from Raza may have just taken the game away from the visitors.
FOUR! Lovely finish for Zimbabwe! A fuller one, around middle. Sikandar Raza makes room and drives it through cover for a boundary. Zimbabwe end on 205 for 3!
SIX! BANG! A low full toss, on the pads. Sikandar Raza whips it off his pads over deep square leg for a biggie!  200 up for Zimbabwe!
Wide! Full toss and down the leg side. Sikandar Raza leaves it alone. Wide called!
FOUR! Wonderful shot! An overcooked delivery, around middle. Sikandar Raza stands deep in his crease and lifts it over the bowler's head or a boundary.
Wesley Madhevere is walking off the field! He seems to have hurt himself while diving in to make his ground.

Another good ball! Yorker, around middle. Sikandar Raza works it away towards mid-wicket for a brace. That brings up his fifty! What a good knock this has been from the veteran! He continues his good form.
Another yorker, around middle. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards mid-wicket. Only a single.
A yorker-length delivery, around middle. Sikandar Raza digs it out past the bowler, towards long on for a single.
Very full this time, around middle. Sikandar Raza makes room and drives it to deep cover for a single.
Another slower ball, outside off, on a length ball. Wesley Madhevere looks to push this away on the off side, but the ball goes off the bottom edge and towards the left of the keeper. A single taken!
Leg bye! A slower ball, very full, on the pads. Sikandar Raza looks to flick this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads. The ball rolls towards point and the batters pick up a leg bye!

SIX! Make that 16 runs off the over so far! Back-to-back sixes! A short one, outside off. Sikandar Raza shuffles across and scoops it over the keeper's head, towards third man all the way for a biggie! 200 is on the cards for Zimbabwe!
SIX! This is bigger and better! A fuller one again, around off. Sikandar Raza shimmies down the track and dispatches this over long off for a biggie! 10 runs already off the over!
FOUR! Crunched! Ocverpitched delivery, outside off. Sikandar Raza lunges forward and drives it powerfully wide of long off for a boundary. Once again a boundary on the first ball of the over!
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A shorter one, down the leg side. Wesley Madhevere swivels and pulls it towards fine leg for the third boundary in the over.
Width on offer now, shorter ball. Sikandar Raza chops it towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Sikandar Raza gets down on his knee and looks to sweep this one. The ball goes off the top edge over short fine leg for a boundary.
Good ball! Slower one, length ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza looks to pull this one away but he misses.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Wesley Madhevere flicks it in the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.

FOUR! Zimbabwe are dealing in boundaries here! A fuller one, around middle. Wesley Madhevere heaves it aerially towards mid-wicket. The ball goes one bounce over the ropes for a boundary. Good start to the over!
A length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere slices it uppishly over point for a single. He retains the strike!
FOUR! Gorgeous shot! Overpitched, outside off. Wesley Madhevere presses forward and drives it through cover for a glorious boundary.
Wide! Fuller one, wide of off. Wesley Madhevere leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, slower in pace, wide of off. Wesley Madhevere shuffles across and looks to cut this away but he misses.
Another low full toss, outside off. Sikandar Raza slices it towards point for a single.
A low full toss, slower in pace. Wesley Madhevere hits it towards the fielder at long on. Only a run!
Wide! Very full and wide of off. Wesley Madhevere looks to slash this but he misses. Wide called!

FOUR! Three boundaries in a row for Bangladesh! This is short and wide of off. Wesley Madhevere stays in his crease and slaps it through cover for a boundary. Wesley Madhevere brings up his fifty in style! His 7th T20I fifty!

FOUR! Streaky boundary, but Zimbabwe will mind that! A length ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza dances down the track and looks to heave this over mid-wicket but the ball goes off the outside and flies over short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away! Another shorter ball, around middle. Sikandar Raza pulls it in the gap between deep square leg and fine leg for a boundary.
A low full toss, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere flicks it to the fielder at deep square leg. Single taken!
Drops it short again, around his hips. Sikandar Raza just helps it towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, slower in pace, shorter ball as well. Wesley Madhevere pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Slower length ball, on his thigh pad. Sikandar Raza tucks it towards square leg. Single taken!
Shoriful Islam comes back into the attack!
Fuller now, around off. Sikandar Raza pushes it down to long off for a single.
SIX! BANG! That sounded so sweet as soon as it left the bat! Shorter ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza swivels and pulls it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Much fuller now, around middle. Wesley Madhevere drives it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shorter and down the leg side. Wesley Madhevere pulls it gently towards fine leg for a boundary.
Shorter in length. Sikandar Raza tucks it off his hips and towards fine leg for a single.
A low full toss, on the pads. Wesley Madhevere flicks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter one, wide of off. Sikandar Raza cuts it towards point. Mosaddek Hossain dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Back of a length, around middle. Sikandar Raza stays in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter one, around middle and leg. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards square leg for a single.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! A fuller down, spinning down the leg side. Wesley Madhevere looks to sweep this but the ball goes off his gloves onto the pads.
And again! Another fuller ball, around middle. Wesley Madhevere once again reverse-sweeps this aerially towards deep point. Two taken!
FOUR Wonderful shot! A fuller one, around middle. Wesley Madhevere gets on his knee and reverse-sweeps this over point for a boundary.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Bangladesh have been really sloppy in the field! A shortish ball, on the hips. Sikandar Raza flicks it aerially towards fine leg. The fielder runs forward and tries to grab the ball on the bounce but he fails to do so, it rolls behind him towards the boundary.
Slower one, very full, around middle. Wesley Madhevere digs it out towards mid on for a single.
Quick single! A length ball, slower one, around middle. Sikandar Raza taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. Wesley Madhevere dives in to make his ground.
A length ball, on the pads. Sikandar Raza tucks it through square leg for a brace. He is off the mark straightaway!
Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Getting back Mustafizur Rahman into the attack has done the trick! Much-needed wicket for Bangladesh as this partnership was looking threatening. A length ball, slower in pace, around off. Sean Williams makes room and looks to drive this through cover, but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto the stumps. Zimbabwe have lost their third wicket.
Fuller one, around middle. Wesley Madhevere looks to drive this one but he gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on!
Tad shorter, around middle. Wesley Madhevere flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Huge over for Zimbabwe. 18 runs off it!
Shorter, flatter and quicker, around middle. Sean Williams works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Another boundary in the over! It's hit on the leg side once again! A shorter one, around middle. Sean Williams uses the depth of his crease, swilevs and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Leading edge but safe! A shorter one, around the pads. Sean Williams looks to flick this one, but he gets a leading edge behind the bowler. Two taken!
FOUR! Six followed by a four! 10 runs off the first two balls! A fuller one, down the leg side. Sean Williams sweeps it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
SIX! Bang! Good timing on that! A full toss from Nasum Ahmed, around middle. Sean Williams gets low and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie!
Tosses it up, very full, around off. Wesley Madhevere digs it out towards cover.
Pitches up, around off. Sean Williams pushes it down the ground towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller ball delivery, slower through the air. Sean Williams gets down on his knee and sweeps it from outside off along the ground towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Tosses it up, full and around middle. Sean Williams reverse-sweeps this to the fielder at backward point.
Shorter one, outside off. Sean Williams stays in his crease and cuts it towards cover.
Afif Hossain begins with a very full delivery, on middle. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it towards square leg. Single taken!
Another slower ball, on the pads, a length ball. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards mid-wicket for a single. Zimbabwe are 74 for 2 at the halfway mark!
Back of a length, outside off. Sean Williams pushes it towards mid off for a single.
An off-pace delivery, around middle and leg, on a length. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another shorter ball, around the leg pole. Wesley Madhevere pulls this one towards fine leg for a boundary.
A yorker now, around middle. Sean Williams squeezes it towards square leg for a single.
Leg bye! A slower shorter, on the chest. Wesley Madhevere looks to pull this one but he misses. The ball hits his chest and goes towards square leg. A leg bye taken!
Slower through the air, full, around middle and off. Wesley Madhevere mistimes his sweep shot towards square leg for a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Sean Williams drives it towards cover. A midfield there allows the batter to sneak in a run!
On the pads now, fuller ball. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards square leg for a single.
Full toss, and outside off. Wesley Madhevere drives it to the fielder at cover.
Darting it around the hips, shorter one. Sean Williams tucks it towards short fine leg for a quick single. Good running!
Tosses this one up, around the leg pole/. Wesley Madhevere flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Pitches it up again, darting it on the pads. Sean Williams tucks towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Sean Williams reverse-sweeps this past point for a boundary.
Full and on the pads. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Pitches it up, around middle. Sean Williams knocks it down to long on for a single.
Tosses it up, full and on the pads. Wesley Madhevere leans forward and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fires it quick and flatter, outside off. Sean Williams looks to chop this away but he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller again, around middle. Wesley Madhevere works it away towards long on for a single.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Wesley Madhevere drives it wide of long on. A midfield there but the fielder allows the batter to take two runs!
FOUR! Swept away! Fuller one, around middle. Wesley Madhevere gets down on his knee and reverse-seeps this over short third man for a boundary.
Short again, around middle and leg. Sean Williams flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Sean Williams comes to the crease!

OUT! TIMBER! Mosaddek Hossain gets rid of the Zimbabwe skipper! A big wicket for Bangladesh! Mosaddek Hossain goes 'round the wicket, serves a shorter one, quicker as well. This one comes in with the arm. Craig Ervine uses the depth of the crease and looks to push this away but he misses and the ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Zimbabwe are 2 down!
Width on offer now, shortish ball. Wesley Madhevere looks to slash this away but he gets a bottom edge onto the deck and back to the keeper. Zimbabwe are 43 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Shorter one this time, around middle and leg. Craig Ervine swivels and pulls it to the fielder at deep square leg. Only a single.
Another full delivery, outside off. Wesley Madhevere drives it to the left of mid off and takes a quick single.
Fuller one, outside off. Wesley Madhevere drives this one but he finds the fielder at cover.
EDGED AND FOUR! Fuller and wide of off. Wesley Madhevere drives this one away from his body, but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the keeper and towards third man for a boundary.
Direct hit but the Wesley Madhevere was well in! A length ball, darting it on the hips. Craig Ervine tucks it towards the fielder at short fine leg and he scampers across to the other end.
Quick single! Tad fuller, outside off. Craig Ervine taps it towards backward point and takes a single.
On a length, outside off. Craig Ervine dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.
Angling in, around the pads, fuller ball. Wesley Madhevere flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Wesley Madhevere dabs it towards point. No run there!
Short again, width on offer. Craig Ervine cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Shortish ball, outside off. Craig Ervine opens the face of the bat and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Leg bye! Lovely ball! Quicker, flatter, and on the pads. Craig Ervine steps down and looks to flick this one but he misses. The ball hit him on his pads and goes mid-wicket. Leg bye taken!
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller one. Craig Ervine leaves it alone. Wide called!
Fuller, wide of off. Craig Ervine drives it through cover-point for a brace.
This one comes in with the arm, fuller one, around leg. Craig Ervine looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. An appeal there for LBW, but turned down by the umpire!
Spinning in, around middle and leg. Wesley Madhevere flicks it towards square leg for a single.

Another full ball, around the leg pole. Craig Ervine advances down the track and flicks it in the gap between mid-wicket. A slight misfield there by Afif Hossain allows the batters to take three runs!
Mosaddek Hossain starts off with a full toss, around middle. Wesley Madhevere steps down the track and knocks it to long on for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Craig Ervine drives it to the fielder at cover. End of a successful first over from Mustafizur Rahman!
Wide! Down the leg side, shorter ball. Craig Ervine looks to pull this but he misses. Wide called!
FOUR! Glorious! Fuller one, outside off. Craig Ervine presses forward and creams his drive through cover for a boundary.
Wesley Madhevere is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Mustafizur Rahman strikes in his first over! Regis Chakabva looks to go big but he holes out! A length ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva looks to heave this one over mid-wicket. But there is no timing on that. He gets only elevation and no distance. Najmul Hossain Shanto at mid-wicket settles under it and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, shaping away a tad, outside off. Craig Ervine cuts it towards point for a single.
Good running again! Fuller now, on the pads. Craig Ervine flicks it in the vacant mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Mustafizur Rahman begins with a shortish ball, outside off. Craig Ervine pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller now, around the leg pole. Regis Chakabva looks to sweep this one but he misses.
Shorter one, around middle. Regis Chakabva pushes it back to the bowler.
Goes over the wicket now, serves a fuller ball, around middle and leg. Craig Ervine drives it towards mid on and takes a single.
Pitches it up again, quicker, around middle. Regis Chakabva taps it in the vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
Much fuller now, on the pads. Regis Chakabva leans forward and tucks it towards square leg.
Nasum Ahmed begins with a shortish ball, drifting in, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva pushes it towards wide of long on for a brace. Good running!
It will be spin from the other end as Nasum Ahmed comes into the attack.
Short and width on offer. Craig Ervine cuts it to the fielder at cover. 8 runs off the first over!
Pulls his length back now, serves it around the thigh pad. Regis Chakabva tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller this time, on the pads. Regis Chakabva flicks it aerially over mid-wicket for a boundary. First boundary of the innings and Regis Chakabva is off the mark in style!
Good-length delivery, swinging in, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva blocks it towards mid on.
Better line now! Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva pushes it towards mid on.
Wide! Taskin Ahmed errs in line again as he spills this down the leg side for the third time. Wided!
Wide! Back of a length again, down the leg side again. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone. Wide given!
Slightly shorter now, around off, extra bounce there as well. Regis Chakabva does well to fend it away towards point.
Wide! Taskin Ahmed begins with a fuller ball, down the leg side. Regis Chakabva misses his flick and a wide is called! Zimbabwe are underway with that!

We are all set for action to get underway! The players are out in the middle. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine will open the batting for Zimbabwe. Taskin Ahmed will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
It's time for the National Anthems! All the players have lined up for their respective national anthems. It will be Bangladesh's first followed by that of Zimbabwe.

Nurul Hasan the captain of Bangladesh says that he is happy to be here and is happy with the toss as well. Says that the wicket is looking good and they are looking for the challenge to bat second. Informs that there are a few changes to their side from their previous series against West Indies and the team is looking good.

Craig Ervine the skipper of Zimbabwe says they are going to bat first. Adds that the wicket looks good, and they are sticking to their recent strength of batting first. Mentions that he is happy to win the qualifiers but now they need to assess the conditions here quickly.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo is pitchside. He says that there is not a lot of moisture underneath the surface. There is just a tinge of grass but the conditions are ideal for batting. Mentions that the captain winning the toss should bat fist and put the team batting second under pressure.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Litton Das, Munim Shahriar, Anamul Haque, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mosaddek Hossain, Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (C/WK), Nasum Ahmed, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Milton Shumba, Ryan Burl, Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Richard Ngarava, Tanaka Chivanga.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

Bangladesh on the other hand will be without a few of their experienced players. With Mahmudullah being rested the visitors will be led by Nurul Hasan. This is a great opportunity for their young guns to step up. After continuous losses in this format, Bangladesh will be eyeing to make a comeback. As their stand-in skipper, Nurul Hasan quoted they want to play ‘Fearless’ cricket and we can expect them to come out all guns blazing. Who will begin this series on the right foot? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
